title: Freshservice Review (2026)
intro: Freshservice is evaluated here as an IT service desk / ITSM platform — Freshservice is Freshworks' IT service management (ITSM) platform for incidents, problems, changes, assets, and employee service desks. Annual per-agent pricing: Starter $19, Growth $49, Pro $99 per agent/month billed annually. Scored as itsm-service-desk primary — ranked only within ITSM landscape, not against helpdesk or live-chat peers. Distinct from Freshdesk (customer helpdesk) and Freshchat (live chat). This review uses SoftwareGlimpse's customer-service methodology (ease of use, support job fit, workflow depth, omnichannel, self-service, integrations, analytics, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Freshservice when ITSM and internal employee service desk is the primary job — not customer ecommerce helpdesk or website live chat.
verdict: Choose Freshservice when ITSM and internal employee service desk is the primary job — not customer ecommerce helpdesk or website live chat. Do not force-rank against Freshdesk, Zendesk Suite, or live-chat peers. Compare ServiceNow or Jira Service Management for enterprise ITSM alternatives outside this wave. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: ITSM breadth (incidents, changes, assets) is heavier than Freshdesk’s customer helpdesk. First-party research supports a modern IT workspace — not a shared-inbox SMB setup.
ITSM service desk is documented as supported; ecommerce-helpdesk is not. Distinct from Freshdesk (customer tickets) and Freshchat (live chat). Score it only inside ITSM.
Ticketing, SLA routing, and macros/automation are supported alongside incidents, problems, changes, and assets. This is ITIL-style workflow depth, not a customer omnichannel inbox.
Omnichannel inbox and live chat are only limited in first-party research; phone-support is not supported. Employee service desk channels — not Zendesk-style customer omnichannel.
Knowledge-base and employee self-service portal are documented as supported. That is an internal request portal, not a DTC help-center motion.
Helpdesk/ITSM integrations are documented as supported. Treat Freshworks adjacency as optional — the job is IT operations, not stitching a customer helpdesk.
Helpdesk reporting is documented as supported for IT queues. Confirm which ITSM dashboards (changes, assets, SLAs) ship on Starter vs Growth vs Pro.
Published per-agent ladder: Starter $19, Growth $49, Pro $99/month billed annually. Scale is agent count and ITIL process depth — not ticket packs.
No perpetual free plan in first-party research; a trial is documented. The $19 Starter tile is a published ITSM floor versus ServiceNow contact-sales packaging — confirm live SKUs.
Chatbot/AI agent and agent copilot are documented (Freddy AI for IT). Expect IT ops assistance, not ecommerce deflection bots. Confirm which AI features are gated by plan.

faq.question: Is Freshservice customer service software?
faq.answer: Yes. Freshservice is evaluated as an IT service desk / ITSM platform.

faq.question: How is Freshservice priced?
faq.answer: Annual per agent: Starter $19, Growth $49, Pro $99/mo. 14-day trial. ITSM/service desk — not Freshdesk customer helpdesk.

faq.question: Does Freshservice have a free plan or free trial?
faq.answer: No free plan is published. A free trial is documented (about 14 days). Confirm current terms with the vendor.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test Freshservice?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage. Affiliate relationships never influence scores.
